name: com.studiogaku.input-command
description: Turns discrete input commands into one deterministic tick-driven pipeline that buffers early presses, matches sequences and chords, arbitrates by priority, resolves opposing axis inputs, and debounces unstable commands.

samples.description: Explicit-tick recording, in-window FIFO consumption, expiry, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Light-Light-Heavy matching, gap timeout and restart, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Inclusive chord span, rearm, late rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
No selection, highest-priority selection, stable first-index ties, duplicate rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Last-pressed-wins, release fallback, same-tick tie, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Candidate progress, third-sample commit, noise cancellation, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
